summary: Activate all built-but-inactive chatbot features across 10 phases. The chatbot has complete backend code, DB models, API routers, and React components from plans CHATBOT a-h and G1-G4, but most features are not mounted in the UI, have broken route wiring, lack auth scoping, or depend on missing runtime workers/providers. This plan systematically activates each feature area in dependency order: visibility first, then runtime, then memory, then progressively deeper feature areas, finishing with integration verification.
async_strategy: Phases are sequential because each phase depends on prior phase outputs. Within phases, tasks that touch disjoint files can run in parallel. Tasks modifying App.tsx, app.py, config.py, or models.py must be serialized via dependencies.
backend_recommendations: Use codex_cli for complex multi-file wiring tasks (no model field). Use pi_cli with openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro for medium complexity tasks. Use pi_cli with openrouter/qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507 for reasoning/verification tasks. Use pi_cli with openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905 for simple focused fixes. Use antigravity_cli for docs, audits, and investigations (no model field). Each task below specifies its backend and model explicitly.
risks: Route prefix mismatches between Vite proxy and backend routers are a recurring pattern — every phase touching API routes must verify the full proxy path.
Auth ownership checks must be added before any UI exposure — the assessment found memory, config, agency, rooms, admin, and streaming endpoints without auth.
Continuity table/model name mismatches may require migration reconciliation before continuity features can work.
Voice and visual features depend on external provider APIs that may not be available — tasks must fail clearly when unconfigured.
Background worker design affects memory, continuity, and agency — Phase 2 must be solid before Phases 3 and 5.

phases.title: Feature Visibility, Route Fixes, and App Shell
phases.description:
Fix frontend/backend route mismatches, register missing routers, add auth ownership to unsafe endpoints, and build a navigable app shell that mounts existing React components.

This phase MUST produce exactly 12 tasks as specified below:

Task a.1: Fix memory router prefix — change from /api/memories to /memories in chatbot/api/memory.py. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905

Task a.2: Fix voice router prefix — change from /api/voice to /voice in chatbot/api/voice.py. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905

Task a.3: Register companion router — create chatbot/api/companions.py using existing CompanionManager, register in app.py. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro

Task a.4: Register continuity routers — create chatbot/api/continuity.py with /timeline, /narrative, /rituals routes matching frontend client paths, register in app.py. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro

Task a.5: Add auth ownership to config endpoints — add get_current_user dependency to chatbot/api/config.py, verify session belongs to current user. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905

Task a.6: Add auth to memory endpoints — add get_current_user dependency to chatbot/api/memory.py, scope queries by user. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905

Task a.7: Add auth to agency endpoints — add get_current_user dependency to chatbot/api/agency.py, remove arbitrary user_id params. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905

Task a.8: Add auth to rooms endpoints — add get_current_user dependency to chatbot/api/rooms.py, remove arbitrary user_id params. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905

Task a.9: Add admin auth gate — add admin authorization check to chatbot/api/admin.py endpoints. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905

Task a.10: Add auth to streaming endpoint — add auth dependency, session ownership check, DB history loading, and message persistence to chatbot/api/streaming.py. selected_backend: pi_cli, model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro

Task a.11: Build navigable app shell — add tabbed/panel navigation to react_ui/src/App.tsx for settings, memory, timeline, rooms, voice, admin panels. Create AppShell.tsx and SettingsPanel.tsx. selected_backend: codex_cli

Task a.12: Mount CompanionSelector in auth flow — wire CompanionSelector into the authenticated app flow in App.tsx so users can create/select companions. Depends on a.3 and a.11. selected_backend: codex_cli
phases.async_notes: Tasks a.1 through a.9 are independent and can run in parallel (disjoint files). a.10 is independent. a.11 depends on route fixes. a.12 depends on a.3 and a.11.
phases.risks: Exposing UI for endpoints that still lack auth is a data isolation risk. Verify auth is applied before mounting any panel.
